critical_code_review_comments: ReadinessCard.jsx: 403 → hidden, 503 with checks → still renders detail. Correct dual-path; non-admin users won't see the card at all (good UX).
ReadinessCard.jsx line 47-48: 30s polling via setInterval — with dependency [load] and load is stable (useCallback with []), no leak. Good.

JournalCardModal.jsx: generate() runs once on mount and on force-regenerate; busy state guards double-clicks. share_url falls back to null on revoke → 'SHARE LINK REVOKED' banner shows. Clean state machine.
PublicJournal.jsx: uses raw axios (not `api` instance) — correct, since public endpoint must NOT send credentials/cookies. Good separation.

AuthContext.jsx: /me is called once in useEffect; setUser(false) on any error prevents infinite spinner. The 'INITIALIZING TERMINAL' splash from ProtectedRoute only holds while user===null (before /me settles). Zero risk of hang in this codepath — main agent's splash stall was clearly a sandbox/tool-specific issue and does NOT reproduce in a real browser context.
